pr_body:
This fixes that serialization of the `SingleValueQuery` during the `can_match` phase.

Closes #111726
Closes #111701
pr_comments: Hi @nik9000, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
I'm going to merge this one now to fix the tests but will do a little refactoring in a follow up.

comments:
I think this is the same as https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/111701.

Set risk to `blocker` since this affects release builds.

review_comments:
Thought: Maybe we should abstract reading the three ints into a `readOptionalSourcePosition` or so (whose return value we discard)?

That is duplicated in `readFrom`; factoring into a method would have a higher chance of staying in sync with `readFrom`
I couldn't find a `CanMatch.java`. Could we maybe rephrase the comment here a little so it's clear when this would be deserialized without a `PlanStreamInput`? It's currently unclear to me.

I didn't want to make an `if instanceof` thing, but I think this is an appropriate work around in the short term. Maybe in the long term. We don't need this for most plan things so I like that we're isolating this at least.
Thought: instead of an empty source, would it be reasonable to keep at least the line, column, and length around for debugging?

Another (minor) idea could be to "normally" `readFrom()` and then just `this.source = Source.EMPTY;` here, rather than make SVG's need Source's concern.
But either way is 👍 .
